Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport ( Railway Investment and Development Division ), 044-201-4133, 3986

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「도시철도법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Urban Railway Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(도시철도망구축계획의 내용) 「도시철도법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제5조제2항제5호에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Contents of Urban Railway Network Construction Plan) The term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” in Article 5, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 5 of the Urban Railway Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) refers to the following matters:

rows.source_ko: 1. 도시철도망구축계획의 노선별 우선순위 설정을 위한 종합평가
rows.text_en: 1. Comprehensive Evaluation for Setting Priorities by Route in the Urban Railway Network Construction Plan
2. Urban Railway Construction Methods
3. Types of Urban Railway Vehicles and Operation Plan

rows.source_ko: 제3조(노선별 도시철도기본계획의 내용) 법 제6조제2항제8호에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Contents of Basic Urban Railway Plan by Route) The term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” in Article 6, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 8 of the Act refers to the following matters:
1. Urban railway construction methods
2. Types of Urban Railway Vehicles and Operation Plan

rows.source_ko: 제3조의2(노후화된 도시철도차량) 법 제22조제7항에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 노후화된 도시철도차량”이란 「철도안전법 시행규칙」 제75조의13제1항 각 호에 따른 정밀안전진단기간의 다음 날부터 5년이 지난 도시철도차량을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3-2 (Aging Urban Railway Vehicles) In Article 22, Paragraph 7 of the Act , “aging urban railway vehicles prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” refers to urban railway vehicles for which five years have passed since the day following the detailed safety diagnosis period under each subparagraph of Article 75-13, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Rule of the Railway Safety Act .
[This Article Newly Inserted July 13, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(사업의 면허 절차 및 면허증 발급 등) ① 법 제26조제1항에 따라 도시철도운송사업의 면허를 받으려는 자는 별지 제1호서식의 도시철도운송사업 면허신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 특별시장ㆍ광역시장ㆍ특별자치시장ㆍ도지사 및 특별자치도지사(이하 “시ㆍ도지사”라 한다)에게 제출하여야 한다. 이 경우 시ㆍ도지사는 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서(설립예정 법인인 경우를 제외한다)를 확인하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Procedures for Business Licensing and Issuance of License, etc.) ① A person who intends to obtain a license for urban railway transportation business pursuant to Article 26(1) of the Act shall submit an application for a license for urban railway transportation business in the form of Annex No. 1, along with the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Mayor of a Special City, Metropolitan City, Special Self-Governing City, Governor of a Province, or Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as “Mayor/Provincial Governor”). In this case, the Mayor/Provincial Governor shall verify the certificate of corporate registration (excluding cases of a corporation to be established) through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36(1) of the Electronic Government Act.
1. Urban Rail Transportation Business Plan
2. Plan for Incorporation (limited to cases of a corporation to be established)

rows.source_ko: 3. 해당 운송사업을 경영하고자 하는 취지를 설명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 3. Documents explaining the intent to operate the relevant transportation business

rows.source_ko: 4. 신청인이 법 제28조제1항 각 호의 결격사유에 해당하지 아니함을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 4. Documents proving that the applicant does not fall under any of the grounds for disqualification in each subparagraph of Article 28, Paragraph 1 of the Act

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항제1호에 따른 도시철도운송사업계획서에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The urban railway transportation business plan pursuant to Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 shall include the following matters:
1. Starting point, ending point, and station of the operating section
2. Types of urban railway transportation businesses, such as passenger and freight transportation
3. Number, types, and procurement plan of urban railway rolling stock to be used
4. Number of Runs, Operating Schedule, and Track Capacity Usage Plan

rows.source_ko: 5. 해당 도시철도운송사업을 위하여 필요한 자금의 내역과 조달방법
rows.text_en: 5. Details of funds required for the relevant urban railway transportation business and methods of procurement

rows.source_ko: 6. 도시철도의 역ㆍ차량정비기지 등 도시철도의 운영을 위한 시설 개요
rows.text_en: 6. Overview of facilities for urban railway operation, such as stations and rolling stock depots

rows.source_ko: 7. 도시철도차량의 운전ㆍ운행관리 종사자의 자격사항, 확보 현황 및 확보 방안
rows.text_en: 7. Qualifications, Current Status, and Measures for Securing Personnel for the Operation and Management of Urban Railway Vehicles

rows.source_ko: 8. 여객ㆍ화물의 취급예정수량 및 그 산출의 기초와 예상 사업수지
rows.text_en: 8. Estimated handling volume of passengers and cargo, basis for calculation, and projected business balance

rows.source_ko: ③ 시ㆍ도지사는 제1항에 따른 면허신청을 받은 경우에는 법 제27조에 따른 면허기준에의 적합 여부, 법 제28조제1항 각 호의 결격사유에 해당하는지 여부 및 도시철도운송사업계획서의 타당성 여부 등을 종합적으로 심사하여 면허 여부를 결정하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When a mayor or provincial governor receives an application for a license pursuant to Paragraph 1, they shall determine whether to grant the license by comprehensively reviewing whether it meets the licensing standards pursuant to Article 27 of the Act , whether it falls under any of the grounds for disqualification in each subparagraph of Article 28 Paragraph 1 of the Act , and whether the urban railway transportation business plan is valid.

rows.source_ko: ④ 시ㆍ도지사는 도시철도운송사업의 면허를 하기로 결정한 경우에는 신청인에게 별지 제2호서식의 도시철도운송사업 면허증을 발급하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ When a mayor or provincial governor decides to grant a license for an urban railway transportation business, they shall issue an urban railway transportation business license in the form of Annex 2 to the applicant.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 시ㆍ도지사는 제4항에 따라 도시철도운송사업 면허증을 발급할 때에는 해당 면허증 사본과 별지 제3호서식의 면허대장에 이를 기재ㆍ관리하여야 하며, 해당 면허대장을 국토교통부장관 또는 「대도시권 광역교통 관리에 관한 특별법」 제8조에 따른 대도시권광역교통위원회(도시철도운송사업 사업구간의 전부 또는 일부가 「대도시권 광역교통 관리에 관한 특별법」 제2조제1호에 따른 대도시권 안에 있는 경우에 한정한다. 이하 “대도시광역교통위원회”라 한다)에 제출해야 한다. <개정 2019. 10. 14.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ When a Mayor or Provincial Governor issues a license for urban railway transportation business pursuant to Paragraph 4, they shall record and manage a copy of the said license and the license register in the form of Annex 3 , and shall submit the said license register to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport or the Metropolitan Area Wide-Area Transportation Committee pursuant to Article 8 of the Special Act on the Management of Metropolitan Area Wide-Area Transportation (limited to cases where all or part of the business section of the urban railway transportation business is located within a metropolitan area as defined in Article 2, Subparagraph 1 of the Special Act on the Management of Metropolitan Area Wide-Area Transportation ; hereinafter referred to as the “Metropolitan Area Wide-Area Transportation Committee”). <Amended Oct. 14, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 제5조(면허의 기준) 법 제27조제2호에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 기준”이란 별표 1에서 정하는 기준을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Standards for License) In Article 27, subparagraph 2 of the Act , “standards prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport”refers to the standards prescribed in Annex 1 .

rows.source_ko: 제5조의2(도시철도부대사업의 승인 신청 등) ① 도시철도운영자는 법 제28조의2제1항에 따라 도시철도부대사업의 승인을 받으려는 경우에는 다음 각 호의 사항을 포함한 사업계획서를 시ㆍ도지사에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5-2 (Application for Approval of Urban Railway Ancillary Business, etc.) ① If an urban railway operator intends to obtain approval for an urban railway ancillary business pursuant to Article 28-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the operator shall submit a business plan including the matters of each of the following subparagraphs to the Mayor or Provincial Governor.
1. Name and Purpose of Urban Railway Ancillary Business
2. Project Period
3. Project costs
4. Financing Plan
5. Plan for the utilization of proceeds generated from urban railway ancillary businesses

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 사업계획서를 제출받은 시ㆍ도지사는 제1항 각 호의 사항에 대하여 타당성과 적정성 등을 검토하여 승인 여부를 결정하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The mayor or provincial governor who receives a business plan pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall review the validity and appropriateness of the matters in each subparagraph of Paragraph 1 and decide whether to approve it.
[This Article Newly Inserted Nov. 21, 2014]

rows.source_ko: 제5조의3(운임 신고의 수리기간) 법 제31조제1항에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 기간”이란 60일을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5-3 (Period for Acceptance of Freight Rate Reports) In Article 31, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the term “period prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” refers to 60 days.
[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 8, 2020]

rows.source_ko: 제5조의4(도시철도운송약관 신고의 수리기간) 법 제32조 전단에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 기간”이란 60일을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5-4 (Period for Acceptance of Report on Urban Railway Transportation Terms and Conditions) In the first part of Article 32 of the Act , the term “period prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” refers to 60 days.
[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 8, 2020]

rows.source_ko: 제5조의5(도시철도운송사업계획 변경신고의 수리기간) 법 제33조제1항에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 기간”이란 60일을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5-5 (Period for Acceptance of Notification of Change in Urban Railway Transportation Business Plan) In Article 33, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the term “period prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” refers to 60 days.
[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 8, 2020]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(사업의 휴업 또는 폐업 절차) ① 도시철도운송사업자가 법 제36조제1항 본문에 따라 도시철도운송사업의 전부 또는 일부에 대하여 휴업 또는 폐업의 허가를 받으려는 경우에는 휴업 또는 폐업예정일 3개월 전에 별지 제4호서식의 도시철도운송사업휴업(폐업) 허가신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 시ㆍ도지사에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Procedures for Suspension or Closure of Business) ① If an urban railway transportation business operatorintends to obtain permission to suspend or close all or part of an urban railway transportation business pursuant to the main text of Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the operator shall submit to the Mayor or Provincial Governor, three months prior to the scheduled date of suspension or closure, an application for permission to suspend (close) urban railway transportation business in the form of Annex 4, with the following documents attached.

rows.source_ko: 1. 도시철도운송사업의 휴업 또는 폐업에 관한 총회 또는 이사회의 의결서 사본
rows.text_en: 1. Copy of the resolution of the General Assembly or the Board of Directors regarding the suspension or closure of the urban railway transportation business

rows.source_ko: 2. 휴업 또는 폐업하려는 도시철도노선, 정거장, 도시철도차량의 종류 등에 관한 사항을 적은 서류
rows.text_en: 2. Documents containing details regarding the urban railway line, station, type of urban railway vehicle, etc. intended for temporary or permanent closure

rows.source_ko: 3. 휴업 또는 폐업 시 대체교통수단의 이용에 관한 사항을 적은 서류
rows.text_en: 3. Documents stating details regarding the use of alternative transportation in the event of temporary or permanent closure

rows.source_ko: ② 시ㆍ도지사는 제1항에 따른 도시철도운송사업의 휴업 또는 폐업 허가의 신청을 받은 때에는 허가신청을 받은 날부터 2개월 이내에 신청인에게 허가 여부를 통지하여야 하며, 그 결과를 즉시 국토교통부장관 또는 대도시권광역교통위원회에 통보해야 한다. <개정 2019. 10. 14.>
rows.text_en: ② When a Mayor or Provincial Governor receives an application for permission to suspend or cease urban railway transportation business pursuant to Paragraph 1, they shall notify the applicant of whether or not permission is granted within two months from the date of receipt of the application, and shall immediately notify the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport or the Metropolitan Area Wide-Area Transportation Committee of the result. <Amended Oct. 14, 2019>

rows.source_ko: ③ 도시철도운송사업자가 법 제36조제1항 단서에 따라 도시철도운송사업의 휴업을 신고하려는 경우에는 휴업사유가 발생하는 즉시 별지 제4호서식의 도시철도운송사업 휴업신고서에 제1항제2호 및 제3호의 서류를 첨부하여 시ㆍ도지사에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ If an urban railway transportation business operator intends to report the suspension of urban railway transportation business pursuant to the proviso of Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Act , they must submit the report on the suspension of urban railway transportation business in Form No. 4 attached hereto to the mayor or provincial governor immediately upon the occurrence of the cause for suspension, attaching the documents specified in Paragraph 1, Subparagraphs 2 and 3.

rows.source_ko: ④ 법 제36조제1항 단서에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 기간”이란 60일을 말한다. <신설 2020. 9. 8.>
rows.text_en: ④ In the proviso to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the term “period prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” refers to 60 days. <Newly added Sep. 8, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 법 제36조제4항 후단에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 기간”이란 60일을 말한다. <신설 2020. 9. 8.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ In the latter part of Article 36, Paragraph 4 of the Act , the term “period prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” refers to 60 days. <Newly added Sep. 8, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 제7조(행정처분의 세부기준) 법 제37조제2항에 따른 행정처분의 세부기준은 별표 2와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Detailed Standards for Administrative Dispositions) The detailed standards for administrative dispositions pursuant to Article 37, Paragraph 2 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 2 .

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on July 8, 2014.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(다른 법령의 개정) ① 감염병의 예방 및 관리에 관한 법률 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① The Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Prevention and Management of Infectious Diseases are partially amended as follows:
In Item 3 of Annex 7, “station service facilities” shall be changed to “station facilities”.

rows.source_ko: ② 개발이익환수에 관한 법률 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Recapture of Development Profits are partially amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제4조제4항제1호 중 “「도시철도법」 제3조제4호에 따른 도시철도 사업”을 “「도시철도법」 제2조제5호에 따른 도시철도건설사업”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 4, Paragraph 4, Subparagraph 1, “urban railway project pursuant to Article 3, Subparagraph 4 of the Urban Railway Act” shall be changed to “urban railway construction project pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 5 of the Urban Railway Act”.

rows.source_ko: ③ 도시ㆍ군계획시설의 결정ㆍ구조 및 설치기준에 관한 규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Rules on the Determination, Structure, and Installation Standards of Urban and County Planning Facilities are partially amended as follows.
Article 22, subparagraph 2 shall be as follows.
2. Urban railway pursuant to Article 2, subparagraph 2 of the Urban Railway Act

rows.source_ko: ④ 도시철도건설규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: ④ Part of the Urban Railway Construction Rules is amended as follows.
In Article 1, “Article 10-2 of the Urban Railway Act” shall be changed to “Article 18 of the Urban Railway Act”.

rows.source_ko: 제3조 단서 중 “「도시철도법」제3조의2에 따른 도시철도기본계획”을 “「도시철도법」 제6조에 따른 노선별 도시철도기본계획”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the proviso to Article 3, “basic urban railway plan pursuant to Article 3-2 of the Urban Railway Act” shall be changed to “basic urban railway plan by route pursuant to Article 6 of the Urban Railway Act.”

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 도시철도운전규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Urban Railway Operation Rules are partially amended as follows.
In Article 1, “Article 10-2 of the Urban Railway Act” shall be changed to “Article 18 of the Urban Railway Act”.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 도시철도채권 매입사무 취급규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ Part of the Rules on Handling Urban Railway Bond Purchase Procedures is amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제4조의2 중 “「도시철도법」 제13조제1항제2호 단서”를 “「도시철도법」 제21조제1항제2호 단서”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 4-2, “the proviso to Article 13, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Urban Railway Act” shall be changed to “the proviso to Article 21, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Urban Railway Act”.

rows.source_ko: 제5조제2항 중 “영 제12조제2항의 규정에 의하여 채권을 매입하게 하여야 할 의무가 있는자”를 “국가 또는 지방자치단체의 장”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 5, Paragraph 2, “person who has the obligation to have bonds purchased pursuant to the provisions of Article 12, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree” shall be changed to “the State or the head of a local government.”

rows.source_ko: 별표 중 2. 경제개발 또는 공익을 목적으로 제정된 특별법에 의하여 설립된 법인과 그 소속단체의 대상자의 범위란 중 제35호를 다음과 같이 한다.
rows.text_en: Item 35 in the column 2 of the attached table, "Scope of persons subject to corporations and affiliated organizations established under special laws enacted for the purpose of economic development or public interest," shall be as follows:

rows.source_ko: 35. 「도시철도법」에 따라 도시철도건설사업 또는 도시철도운송사업을 위탁받은 법인
rows.text_en: 35. A corporation entrusted with an urban railway construction business or an urban railway transportation business pursuant to the Urban Railway Act

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 매장문화재 보호 및 조사에 관한 법률 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Protection and Investigation of Buried Cultural Heritage are partially amended as follows.
Item 7(b) of Attached Table 1 shall be as follows.
B. Urban railway construction project pursuant to Article 2, subparagraph 5 of the Urban Railway Act

rows.source_ko: ○ 「도시철도법」 제7조에 따른 도시철도사업계획 수립 완료 전
rows.text_en: ○ Before the completion of the urban railway project plan pursuant to Article 7 of the Urban Railway Act

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 지속가능 교통물류 발전법 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: ⑧ Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Sustainable Transport and Logistics Development Act is amended as follows.
Article 8, subparagraph 5 shall be as follows.
5. Station facilities pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 3, Item (a) of the Urban Railway Act

rows.source_ko: 제3조(다른 법령과의 관계) 이 규칙 시행 당시 다른 법령에서 종전의 「도시철도법 시행규칙」 또는 그 규정을 인용한 경우에 이 규칙 가운데 그에 해당하는 규정이 있으면 종전의 규정을 갈음하여 이 규칙 또는 이 규칙의 해당 규정을 인용한 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Relationship with Other Laws and Regulations)  Where, at the time of the enforcement of this Rule, other laws and regulations refer to the former "Enforcement Rules of the Urban Railway Act" or its provisions, and there are corresponding provisions in this Rule, it shall be deemed that this Rule or the relevant provisions of this Rule have been referred to in place of the former provisions.
